_source: Claim pairs for claims.distinct_claims, labelled by hand on 2026-10-15. 'issue': every distinct pair of lines (summary and facts) in the Action Center issues composed 2026-09-24 to 2026-10-15 (production llm_generation_samples, task action_center_issue; the earlier ones were written by a model, before the claim layer, and are kept because a restatement is a restatement however it was written). 'replay': every pair of claims compose() verifies from one cluster's recorded claim calls, 2026-10-11 to 10-15, not already among those. Rerun scripts/calibrate_claim_restatement.py after any change (a test fails until you do).
_rubric: restatement = the two lines report one fact: the same actor doing the same thing to the same object on the same occasion, so a reader learns nothing from the second that matters beyond the first. Different words, a title, a day, a place, a fuller name or who announced it do not make a second fact ('Federal agents raid her home' / 'Federal agents search her D.C. home'; a headline and its lede). Distinct = the second adds another event, statement, figure or party's action ('on the brink of passing' / 'passes'; a judge's order / the White House complying; $10 million / $22 million; a bill introduced / what the bill bans).
